title: Banking Application: Complete Design
description: Design banking application with OOP principles, class diagrams, and scalable C# implementations.

data.text: Design a banking application using object-oriented principles. Focus on clean class design, proper encapsulation, and extensible architecture.

data.caption: Class diagram for Banking Application. Each class encapsulates domain logic and collaborates through well-defined interfaces.

data.caption: Interaction flow for Banking Application. Shows how components collaborate to fulfill a user request.
data.definition:
sequenceDiagram
    participant C as Client
    participant S as BankingApplicationService
    participant AC as Account
    participant TR as Transaction
    participant BA as Bank
    participant CU as Customer

    C->>S: Request
    S->>TR: Deposit()
    TR-->>S: Result
    S->>BA: Withdraw()
    BA-->>S: Result
    S->>CU: Transfer()
    CU-->>S: Result
    S->>CU: GenerateStatement()
    CU-->>S: Result
    S-->>C: Response

data.text: Extend the design with patterns like Strategy, Observer, and Factory to handle complexity and ensure the banking application scales gracefully.

data.title: banking-app.Advanced.cs — Processor Pipeline
Design Principles Applied
data.text: Use composition over inheritance. Keep entities simple. Use interfaces to decouple services from implementations. Apply CQRS when read and write patterns diverge.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Encapsulate state inside entities; expose behavior, not data
Strategy and Command patterns make behavior pluggable
Dependency injection keeps classes loosely coupled
data.takeaway: Banking Application demonstrates how clean OOP design leads to maintainable, testable code that can evolve with requirements.
